items.title: Minneapolis Producer David Z Dead At 78
items.summary: David Z, the Minneapolis musician and producer best-known for his work with Prince, has passed away. The Minneapolis Star-Tribune reports that David Z, born David Rivkin, died in a Burbank, California hospital on Sunday. According to his younger brother Bobby Z, the former drummer from Prince's band the Revolution, David died of complications of an infection. He was 78. The post Minneapolis Producer David Z Dead At 78 appeared first on Stereogum.
